passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Never attain birr until spend from what you love; whatever spend Allah knows; all food lawful to Children of Israel except what Israel forbade himself before Torah revealed; bring Torah recite if truthful; whoever fabricates lie against Allah after that are zalimun; say Allah spoke truth so follow millat Ibrahim hanif not of mushrikin; first house established for mankind at Bakkah blessed guidance for worlds; in it clear signs maqam Ibrahim; whoever enters is secure; pilgrimage to house duty upon mankind for whoever can find way; whoever disbelieves Allah Ghaniyy an al-Alamin; say O People of Book why disbelieve in ayat of Allah Allah shaheed on what you do; say O People of Book why avert from way of Allah those who believe seeking deviation while you are witnesses Allah not ghaafil; O you who believe if obey party of those given Scripture turn you back after belief as kafirun

arabicExcerpts.text: لَن تَنَالُواْ ٱلۡبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُواْ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٞ

۞كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلّٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةُۚ قُلۡ فَأۡتُواْ بِٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ فَٱتۡلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
فَمَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
قُلۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُۗ فَٱتَّبِعُواْ مِلَّةَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيۡتٖ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

فِيهِ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتٞ مَّقَامُ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنٗاۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلۡبَيۡتِ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَاعَ إِلَيۡهِ سَبِيلٗاۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ تَبۡغُونَهَا عِوَجٗا وَأَنتُمۡ شُهَدَآءُۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تُطِيعُواْ فَرِيقٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعۡدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ

mainSubject.label: True righteousness (birr) requires spending from beloved possessions; divine knowledge of all expenditure; historical food-law clarification for Children of Israel: self-imposed restrictions predate Torah; challenge to produce Torah if truthful; fabrication against Allah condemned; affirmation of Allah's truthfulness; command to follow millat Ibrahim hanif; Ka'bah at Bakkah as first house for mankind, blessed, guidance for worlds; clear signs including Maqam Ibrahim; sanctuary security; Hajj as universal obligation conditional on ability; divine self-sufficiency (Ghaniyy) negates need for creation; renewed challenge to Ahl al-Kitab: why disbelieve in Allah's signs while He witnesses; warning against averting believers from Allah's way; caution against obeying factions among Ahl al-Kitab leading to apostasy
